title: lookout input health, version 1
description: lookout's own judgment of one expected input. An input's report about itself can lower this status but never raise it.

status.description: error: the input cannot be read, or reports that it failed. degraded: it was read but cannot be trusted as complete. absent_by_design: the setting expects it to be absent.

reasons.description: Every cause that lowered the status; empty when it is ok.

fetched_at.description: When the source was last read successfully, where the input says.

schema_violations.description: One line per violation: where in the file, and what was wrong.
